theses.title: Amulet of sight supply flood
theses.trigger: The Writing's on the Wall quest, released 3 Nov. The quest gives one amulet free, and Sergeant Hudson sells more.
theses.evidence: The tradeable Amulet of Sight is a quest reward, the first is free, and Hudson sells more. First-day price was 381 GP. https://www.gielinorgains.com/game-updates/2026-11-03-quest-month-kick-off-tfa-tweaks-and-more
theses.mechanism: Every quester gets a free amulet, and an NPC sells unlimited copies. Supply is effectively uncapped, so the price should drift toward the Hudson shop price.
theses.substitutes: Hudson's shop is a perfect substitute. The amulet is also only +10 Ranged attack.
theses.action_detail: Don't buy. If you hold any, sell into early demand now. Check Hudson's price to find the floor.
theses.exit_plan: Re-evaluate only if the price falls to the Hudson price and holds there.
theses.what_would_kill_it: Heavy pure or Ranged-account demand creates a stable premium. Alternatively, Jagex limits Hudson's stock.

theses.title: Graveyard marks flood amylase and stamina
theses.trigger: The Graveyard master quest unlocks a 65+ Agility course. Jagex says it will be the best Marks of Grace source.
theses.evidence: <cite index="21-11">The blog says 30+ Marks of Grace per hour at the top end, aiming to be the best source in the game.</cite> <cite index="47-3">Marks buy amylase, the stamina potion secondary.</cite> https://secure.runescape.com/m=news/the-graveyard---rewards-blog?oldschool=1
theses.mechanism: More marks per hour means more amylase packs, since 10 marks buy 100 crystals. That adds amylase supply and lowers Stamina potion costs. The effect is gradual.
theses.substitutes: Existing rooftop courses already supply marks. Jagex says Ardougne beats the Graveyard's low-intensity option.
theses.action_detail: Sell amylase stock before the quest drops. Don't stockpile stamina ingredients. Re-check after launch day for marks-per-hour reality.
theses.exit_plan: Buy back after the price drops 10-15% and the post-launch flood stabilises.
theses.what_would_kill_it: The master quest gate limits early participation. Or Jagex nerfs mark rates after launch feedback.

theses.title: Underwater gem rocks cut gem prices
theses.trigger: The Deep Sea Diving jewellery areas add new precious and exotic gem rocks, with faster-respawning gold and silver rocks.
theses.evidence: Unconfirmed: poll outcome and gem rates. <cite index="29-7,29-8">Precious rocks (65 Mining) give uncut sapphires, emeralds, rubies and diamonds. Exotic rocks (75 Mining) give opals, jades and red topazes.</cite> https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Update:Deep_Sea_Diving_Expansion
theses.mechanism: New mineable gem supply at high levels should lower raw uncut gem prices if the area passes its poll and rates are decent. Opal, jade and topaz are most exposed.
theses.substitutes: Shilo Village gem rocks, existing mining and drops. Skilled supply is elastic, so the drop is limited.
theses.action_detail: Wait for poll results and rates. Sell any large uncut gem stock before release if the poll passes.
theses.exit_plan: If rates are low or the poll fails, ignore the idea.
theses.what_would_kill_it: The poll fails, rates are poor, or the 65-75 Mining and Sailing gates keep participation small.

theses.title: Underwater farming patches lift rare seeds
theses.trigger: The Deep Sea Diving expansion adds underwater Spirit Tree, Celastrus, Mushroom and Hardwood farming patches.
theses.evidence: Unconfirmed: poll result and seed requirements. <cite index="32-10">The proposal includes an underwater cave farming area with Spirit Tree, Celastrus, Mushroom and Hardwood Tree patches.</cite> https://mmohuts.com/news/old-school-runescape-proposes-deep-sea-diving-and-burial-at-sea-quest
theses.mechanism: Extra patches mean extra seed demand per player. Spirit and celastrus seeds are rare, so they are most sensitive. Mahogany is secondary.
theses.substitutes: Players can skip the patches, and existing patches already supply the produce.
theses.action_detail: Wait for the poll result. If it passes, buy a small amount of Spirit and Celastrus seeds on the release date announcement.
theses.exit_plan: Sell into the first-week spike after release.
theses.what_would_kill_it: The farming area fails its poll, or Sailing and Burial at Sea gates keep early demand small.

theses.title: Zanik crossbow may replace Dorgeshuun crossbow
theses.trigger: The Chosen Commander backport rewards Zanik's Modified Crossbow, a stronger version of the Dorgeshuun crossbow's defence-drain special.
theses.evidence: Unconfirmed: whether Zanik's crossbow is tradeable, plus its stats and requirements. Wiki upcoming-updates page says its special is a stronger defence-draining version of the Dorgeshuun crossbow. https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Upcoming_updates
theses.mechanism: If the quest reward is untradeable and stronger, the Dorgeshuun crossbow loses its niche. If the reward is tradeable, it takes demand and sets a new price.
theses.substitutes: The Dorgeshuun crossbow may keep demand if Zanik's version is slower or limited.
theses.action_detail: Wait for the Chosen Commander rewards blog and poll details. Sell any Dorgeshuun crossbows only if the replacement is clearly better and untradeable.
theses.exit_plan: Exit before release if the details confirm a stronger replacement.
theses.what_would_kill_it: Zanik's crossbow has weak stats, a high requirement, or limited use. The Dorgeshuun crossbow keeps its niche.
